# yyjson

Unmodified [yyjson 0.12.0](https://github.com/ibireme/yyjson/releases/tag/0.12.0).

- Upstream commit: `8b4a38dc994a110abaec8a400615567bd996105f`.
- Files: `src/yyjson.c`, `src/yyjson.h`, and `LICENSE` from that release.
- License: MIT; see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

Plasticine compiles these files directly. Users do not need to install a
separate JSON library. To update, replace both source files and the license
from a fixed upstream release, update this record, and run `make test`.
